name: Surfer Kirsty

intro.text: Flat today. FLAT. I'm in a full wetsuit with nothing to do. Battle me, I'm begging you.

win: That was better than the waves. Don't tell the waves.
after: On a big north swell Thurso East peels right along the reef for ages. The locals call it 'the East'. Visitors call it 'cold'. Everyone calls it amazing.
